twig_templates.elementor/elements/atomic-tab:
{% import 'elementor/macros' as m %}
{% set classes = ['e-con', 'e-atomic-element', base_styles.base, m.default_tag_class('button')] | merge(settings.classes | default([])) | join(' ') %}
<button class="{{ classes }} {{ editor_classes | default('') }}{{ is_active ? ' e--selected' : '' }}"
    data-id="{{ id }}"
    data-element_type="{{ type }}"
    data-e-type="{{ type }}"
    data-interaction-id="{{ interaction_id }}"
    data-interactions="{{ interactions | json_encode | e('html_attr') }}"
    role="tab"
    tabindex="{{ is_active ? '0' : '-1' }}"
    aria-selected="{{ is_active ? 'true' : 'false' }}"
    x-bind="tab"
    x-ref="{{ id }}"
    id="{{ tab_id }}"
    aria-controls="{{ tab_content_id }}"
    {% if settings.attributes is defined and settings.attributes is not empty %}
        {{ settings.attributes | raw }}
    {% endif %}
    {{ editor_attributes | default('') | raw }}><!-- elementor-children-placeholder --></button>

Create collapsible content sections using native <details>/<summary> semantics, with no JavaScript needed for the toggle. Structure: e-accordion contains e-accordion-item elements; each item contains an e-accordion-item-header (holding e-accordion-item-title and an optional e-accordion-item-icon) and an e-accordion-item-content that accepts any element.
A single collapsible accordion item, rendered as <details>. Contains an e-accordion-item-header (the clickable <summary>) and an e-accordion-item-content holding the collapsible body.
The clickable header of an accordion item, rendered as <summary>. Contains an e-accordion-item-title and, when the accordion's Show Icon setting is on, an e-accordion-item-icon indicator.

The title slot of an accordion item header. Always renders as a fixed, non-semantic wrapper; the visible HTML tag is controlled by the inner Paragraph element's own Tag setting. Accepts any element as its content.

The open/closed indicator slot of an accordion item header. Decorative (aria-hidden), and rotated by CSS when the item is open. Holds an e-svg (defaulting to a chevron) by default; the SVG can be replaced.
